<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

`pij pod activity <pod>` shows, read only, what a pod did: its members' state changes, outputs, sends and transcript locations, in order. Any seat may read it.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Anyone can see what a pod did without asking its members.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Access control: there is no observer role, no membership test and no hidden pod.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: indexed reads per member when asked; no launch, loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
